verdict.rationale: The gateway documents policy-driven routing rules at the provider level. `order`, `only`, and `sort` in providerOptions.gateway can rank providers by a cost or performance metric. It also automatically retries other providers when one fails, supports per-provider timeouts for fast failover, and by default picks providers by uptime and latency. However, these rules route among providers serving a chosen model; switching the model itself is shown only as the caller changing the model ID through the unified API, not as a gateway rule. Missing for 10: gateway-level model fallback or model-switching rules, capability-based routing policy, evidence of mid-task model switching for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
